integration_guide.title: Assess applicability
integration_guide.description: Check project platform, requirements, architecture and applicable conditions for Offline, Retry & Synchronization; record exclusions and approved overrides.

integration_guide.title: Apply rules
integration_guide.description: Include applicable Offline, Retry & Synchronization rules in design, implementation and review checklist; link relevant requirement and code.

common_issues.issue: Inconsistent adoption of Offline, Retry & Synchronization
common_issues.cause: Project profile does not explicitly reference the standard or its owner.
common_issues.solution: Attach standard by code to project profile, assign owner and check compliance before change approval.
